title: Singer Menachem Mendel Luk Passes
body: Menachem Mendel Luk, a 55-year-old singer from the Sanzer community, has passed away after suffering a severe stroke at Ichilov Hospital in Tel Aviv.

title: Rav Nebenzahl's Photo Controversy
body: Rav Avigdor Nebenzahl, senior posek and rov of Yerushalayim's Old City, was photographed by Shuki Lerer on Motzoei Shabbos, sparking a question about whether he objected to being photographed before zeman Rabbeinu Tam.
